title: AstroML VariableStarClassification

stats.done_summary: Completed variable vs non-variable classification using symbol_series features. Implemented training/evaluation pipeline (code/train_eval.py), generated validation model comparison plots and extensive diagnostics (ROC/PR, confusion, calibration, probability histograms, permutation importance). Saved outputs (metrics, predictions, importances) under outputs/ and wrote publication-style report to report/report.md with figures in report/images/.
